title: I only made ONE greatest showman reference be proud of me. thank you ...
transcript: this is the greatest show and it's happening right now at Pac NYC this is passengers a new acrobatic show by the 7 Fingers they are a world renowned physical theatre trope from montreal I love circus I went to a summer camp that had a really robust circus program where like all the staff was from Montreal so I was obsessed with this production I was actually invited to come to their rehearsal warm up which was insane the artistry the power it was unreal to watch and passengers is a little more than like a traditional circus show this show is themed around trains and travel it's about the journey of saying goodbye and starting something new the feeling of being in limbo there's also a lot of whimsy there’s storytelling and live music and contemporary dance all mixed in with these incredible skills and this is the first time I've really gotten to check out pac as a venue it is such a cool theater in such a beautiful spot we got to have drinks and snacks on the outdoor terrace they have a great happy hour it was just the perfect place to be preshow on like a beautiful summer day they also have live music going a few days a week and then it was time for the show itself which was even more spectacular than the rehearsal the lighting the music the projections there were so many moments where I and everyone around me were like gasping I just loved it it's running until June 29th if you are a full time educator or you're under 30 you can get a $30 ticket but they also have under $45 tickets to every show this is a really fun one to catch at PAC NYC
classificationReason: This is a review of 'Passengers' by 7 Fingers, which is not a Broadway/West End stage production from the provided list. It's a circus/acrobatic show at PAC NYC.
